title: Disable Gaiapedia
description: A Resource Pack that disables the Gaiapedia from GoG
body:
[![alt text](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/aa8962f9-e6ff-4a83-8eeb-d145d3c55343.webp) ](https://bisecthosting.com/Zoni25)

This is a simple Resource Pack that disables all the entries in the Gaiapedia from [Grimoire of Gaia](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/grimoire-of-gaia).

You need to have GoG installed to see any changes!

I made this mostly for people that only want to use the mobs without any of the other features (me).

If you want to get updates on the pack development, report bugs or suggest new stuff or just contact me join my discord server:
https://discord.com/invite/KWGakdBVwG
